title: Exploring the interaction of curcumin with beta-cyclodextrin and its binding with DNA: A combined spectroscopic and molecular docking study.
authors: Alghamdi, Waad A; Alterary, Seham S; Alarifi, Abdullah; Ramu, Ramith; Khan, Mohd Shahnawaz; Afzal, Mohd
one_liner_zh: 该文通过光谱实验与分子对接研究姜黄素在β-环糊精与DNA间的竞争结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系但对象为小分子-DNA，非TF-DNA，方法仅含分子对接，深度有限。
abstract: At present, a major effort in biophysical studies has been paid towards exploring the interactions and release of therapeutic payloads to the specific site leaving behind healthy cells unaffected and hence, lower the drug-induced toxicity. For the purpose, interaction of beta-bound CUR with calf thymus DNA (ctDNA) has been examined intensely using a series of biophysical methods like absorption, steady state fluorescence emission, and circular dichroism together with molecular docking study. The experimental analysis divulge that CUR interacts with both beta-CD (although with different molar ratio) and DNA. However, the binding affinity of CUR with the target (DNA) is higher than it does with the beta-CD. When beta-CD-carried (10 mM) CUR (muM) (inclusion complex) comes near DNA (15-372 muM), CUR gets out from beta-CD's void and approaches to binds with the DNA. The relocation of the probe occurred due to competitive binding of the CUR between beta-CD and the DNA. The present investigation may provide a simple yet probable route for the transfer of encapsulated therapeutic payload of beta-CD to the most relevant biomolecular target DNA.
abstract_zh: 目前，生物物理研究的一大重点在于探索治疗性药物载荷与特定靶点的相互作用及释放，同时保持健康细胞不受影响，从而降低药物诱导的毒性。为此，本研究通过一系列生物物理方法，如吸收光谱、稳态荧光发射、圆二色光谱，并结合分子对接研究，深入考察了β-环糊精结合的姜黄素与小牛胸腺DNA（ctDNA）之间的相互作用。实验分析表明，姜黄素与β-环糊精（尽管摩尔比不同）和DNA均有相互作用。然而，姜黄素与靶点（DNA）的结合亲和力高于其与β-环糊精的结合。当β-环糊精携带的（10 mM）姜黄素（μM）（包合物）接近DNA（15-372 μM）时，姜黄素从β-环糊精的空腔中释放出来，并与DNA结合。这种探针的转移是由于姜黄素在β-环糊精和DNA之间的竞争性结合所致。本研究可能为β-环糊精包封的治疗性载荷向最相关的生物分子靶点DNA转移提供一条简单而可行的途径。
